sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: In March 2020 CNMI said Milan’s 800 showrooms would participate in new B2B and B2C storytelling as menswear moved to September.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: Which wholesale, ERP or clienteling system converts any named future show into orders remains private unless a brand or vendor documents it.

longform.closing: Milan’s technology is not futurist decoration. It is the system that moves authority from name to room to object to record.

spokenScript: The show is public attention; the showroom is the order system behind it.
In March 2020 CNMI said Milan’s 800 showrooms would participate in new B2B and B2C storytelling as menswear moved to September.
CNMI’s Fashion Showroom surface makes market discovery public, but does not expose private orders, prices, sell-through or customer records.
The system: B2B, B2C, wholesale, market access.
The proof: Milano Moda Uomo moves to September.
The limit: Which wholesale, ERP or clienteling system converts any named future show into orders remains private unless a brand or vendor documents it.
Open the Milan evidence edition: every receipt and permission is attached.
